partB.sql: SELECT audit_id, audit_note, account_id FROM audits
SELECT a.audit_id, a.audit_note, ca.branch_id FROM audits a JOIN chain_accounts ca ON a.account_id = ca.account_id
SELECT audit_id FROM audits WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM chain_accounts WHERE tenant_id = 'tenant_a')
SELECT ca.account_id, ca.balance FROM chain_accounts ca JOIN branches b ON ca.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE b.tenant_id = 'tenant_a'
SELECT ca.account_id, ca.balance FROM chain_accounts ca JOIN branches b ON ca.branch_id = b.branch_id JOIN districts d ON b.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.region_id = 1

SELECT r.region_id, ca.account_id FROM chain_accounts ca JOIN branches b ON ca.branch_id = b.branch_id JOIN districts d ON b.district_id = d.district_id JOIN regions r ON d.region_id = r.region_id WHERE b.tenant_id = 'tenant_a'
SELECT b.branch_id, b.tenant_id FROM branches b JOIN districts d ON b.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.region_id = 1
SELECT audit_id, audit_note FROM audits WHERE account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM chain_accounts)
